text_blocks.answer: For all-around tracking and integration with existing SEO workflows, Semrush is widely considered the best overall AI visibility tool.
Learn more about how technical platforms approach monitoring and optimization by watching this overview on Scrunch AI:
Semrush (AI Toolkit): Best for users already inside an SEO ecosystem. It combines traditional rankings with prompt tracking, competitor benchmarking, and sentiment analysis.

Otterly.AI: Best budget-friendly option for small businesses and solo founders. Plans start around $25–$29/month to track brand mentions, sentiment, and rankings across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. You can explore their features directly on .
Profound: Best for enterprise-level reporting and data-heavy teams needing deep compliance, scale, and multi-model coverage.
Peec AI: Best for e-commerce and agencies. It specializes in URL citation categorization, brand aliases, and multi-client reporting.
Scrunch AI: Best for actionable Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) insights and technical monitoring, offering raw text and citation data via deep response-level APIs.
